purpose.en: Read about ISO output brightness, common myths, and camera-setting examples.
purpose.zh-cn: 了解 ISO 输出亮度、常见误区和相机设置示例。

editorialNote.en: The guide uses the ISO-myth discussion but does not repeat the claim that the lowest ISO is always best.
editorialNote.zh-cn: 本站采用其中对 ISO 误区的讨论，但不照抄“最低 ISO 永远最好”的过度简化。

verification.evidence: The Common ISO Myths section distinguishes output mapping from increased photon collection.
